A report of what went wrong was saved on this device. Sending it helps fix the problem. It holds technical details only: addresses, keys and personal file paths are removed, and nothing is sent unless you choose Send report.
This is everything the report holds. Send report opens a pre-filled issue on GitHub, which you can review before you submit it.
The report was too long for a link, so GitHub got a shortened copy. Copy the full report and paste it into the issue.
Scan this code with your phone\'s camera to open a pre-filled issue on GitHub. You can review it there before you submit it; you need a GitHub account.
To fit in the code, the report is shortened.
QR code with a link to a new issue on GitHub

When StremioNow closes unexpectedly, it can save a report on this device. With Ask me before sending, you can review it and choose to send it the next time you open the app. Nothing is ever sent on its own.
Crash the app on purpose. The report shows on the next launch.

Paired devices on this network will be able to download torrents through this one. Do this only on a network you trust, such as your home\'s, not a café, hotel or office network.
Another device tried to pair with this code. If it wasn\'t yours, someone else on this network is trying to pair: get a new code before typing it on your device.
Not connected to a home network. Connect to Wi-Fi or Ethernet, then turn this on again.
On the other device, open Settings, Other devices, choose this device and enter this code.

How much of the video StremioNow keeps in memory around where you are, so skipping back or forward doesn\'t load it again. It\'s separate from the torrent cache, which is disk space for downloads. Applies from the next video.
Uses less memory. Going back or forward a few seconds may load the video again.
Skips back and forward at once most of the time, without weighing on the computer.
Keeps more of the video to skip without waiting. Uses more memory.
Keeps about %1$s of a 4K film, or %2$s of a 1080p one.
